objective: Harden AER shadow evidence admission, prevent unverified outcome claims from affecting calibration or replay, expose local telemetry durability health, and strengthen policy-promotion evidence requirements.

rulesConsidered: AER is shadow/advisory only until validation and governance promotion.
Evidence references must be resolved against an authoritative source; non-empty strings are not proof.
Model confidence and inference cannot authoritatively resolve operational uncertainty.
Observability records process evidence but does not grant execution or routing authority.
Policy promotion requires held-out replay and calibrated outcome evidence.

notes: Telemetry is metadata-only and does not persist prompts, credentials, raw model content, or chain-of-thought.
Local JSONL file permissions are restricted to owner access where supported; local persistence is not treated as distributed production evidence.
No routing authority or model execution privileges are added.

changes: Added AEROutcomeEvidenceVerifier as a trusted adapter boundary for authoritative receipt verification.
Changed AERMetricsRecorder so missing, rejected, or failing verification does not update calibration or resolution counts.
Added explicit UNVERIFIED_NOT_ADMITTED telemetry for rejected outcome claims.
Required independent outcome verification before shadow replay episodes affect policy comparisons or necessity coverage.
Added unverifiedEpisodeCount and controlledNecessityCoverageRate to shadow replay reports.
Extended AERPolicyPromotionGate to require controlled-necessity coverage and bound missed necessary escalations.
Upgraded JsonlAEREpisodeTelemetrySink to serialized asynchronous appends, fdatasync, restrictive file permissions, and visible health counters.
Added an explicit Node-side AER shadow composition factory that requires a trusted verifier and is not wired to production routing.
Added tests for missing outcome verifier, verified calibration/replay fixtures, telemetry durability, and promotion without necessity evidence.
Documented AER shadow evidence boundaries and outstanding qualification work.
Added aer-remediation.test.ts (evidence-verifier, telemetry durability, shadow replay, promotion gate) to the blocking CI AER test command.
verificationPlan: Run AER core and auxiliary Vitest suites.
Run AER remediation tests including the new verifier, replay, promotion-gate, and telemetry-sink cases.
Run FactoryOS typecheck and repository CI.
Verify missing or failing evidence verifier never contributes to outcome calibration or shadow replay.
Verify local telemetry append failures are visible through sink health and do not affect routing decisions.
Verify the shadow factory is not connected to live production routing and does not alter policy authority.
Keep AER SHADOW / ADVISORY ONLY pending real evidence and governance review.
Confirm aer-remediation.test.ts runs in the blocking repository CI job.

localExecution.note: No repository runtime/test environment was available through the GitHub file interface; local clone access failed because this execution environment could not resolve github.com.

notes: The evidence verifier is an explicit integration contract; no production evidence-store adapter has been implemented by this PR.
The local JSONL sink is crash-durable for its local append but is not replicated, shared across workers, or an authoritative evidence store.
The new factory is a composition helper only. No production runtime currently uses it as a live router.
AER stays shadow-only. The change does not alter CognitiveRouter authority, Guardian, Slayer, Healer, leases, fencing, or F07.
No Ascalon model weights were changed and no fine-tuning job was dispatched.
Promotion still requires real staging shadow episodes, held-out comparisons, calibration, security validation, and explicit human/governance approval.
